v331HotelCardRemediation.description: Dot V330 actual browser measurement: 24 vertical overflows in default Hotel View/Grid; Tehran city 19/23 and 10/13 px, hotel name 65/90 and 30/42 px. V331 computes line-height-aware font ceiling and measures bound card text in the final projected slot via existing text renderer; bounded cache; no text truncation, no preflight suppression.

Grid default rows reserve more vertical capacity and clamp requested spacing within remaining card height. All bound visible card labels fit against final slot dimensions, including edited Component Editor definitions; preserve hidden/static authored elements and underlying data. At minimum 6 px, an unfittable field remains a print-blocking diagnostic.

v331HotelCardRemediation.name: Reproduce Dot V330-RT-001 exactly on the new candidate: one default Hotel View and four-record default Hotel Grid, short names/Tehran, synthetic images and System Logos, Chromium/Linux and Windows/Tahoma when available. Record every name/city/other text frame client/scroll dimensions, verify original full strings, real mixed-card PDF and no tray.

Long Persian/English/mixed names and cities, wrap, font families/weights and line heights .8–4, photo shown/hidden, system labels and custom Component Editor Square/Grid slot resizing; full text, fit against final geometry, correct RTL/LTR, editor/preview/PDF parity and no changes to stored data/definitions.

Deliberately impossible tiny card, long string, border/opacity, font load or fallback and very high spacing; retain actual text, no false PASS, genuine overflow blocks printing, hidden field no false error, no clipped or overlapping rows. Verify cached measurements invalidate after fonts change.

Performance regression: compare V330/V331 render, drag, preview, print preflight, 10/100/500 pages and 1/4/100 hotel cards, cold/warm fit cache, browser layout cost and memory. Preserve source geometry and records after reload, ZIP roundtrip and Undo/Redo.

v332HotelTextRemediation.description: Dot reproduced a long Hotel Text record wrapping into two lines: fixed frame 29 px vs actual 58 px, blocking print in V330 and V331. V332 measures natural wrapped height using the existing text renderer at selected font size, advances subsequent rows by measured height, preserves full underlying text and unchanged print-blocking diagnostics.

Measure custom Hotel Text at its final scaled slot width and typography including borders and effects, without measuring the discarded default layout. Bounded separate 1024-entry height cache invalidated on font loading events. Inline mode verifies total capacity; insufficient or unmeasurable height fails closed. V331 Hotel View/Grid fitting algorithm not changed.

v332HotelTextRemediation.name: Reproduce V331-RT-002 using original fixture, North Riverside Grand Conference Hotel / Newcastle upon Tyne plus rating/year: no overflow in a sufficient Hotel Text frame, same font size, all text preserved, actual mixed Hotel Text/View/Grid PDF without removing Hotel Text. Measure old/new frame and scroll heights.

Multiple records and mixed Persian/English names, multiline fields, inline and newline, separators, bullets, indent, RTL/LTR, custom Component Editor slot width/height/font/border/line-height: verify measured rows, order, non-overlap, full text, unchanged stored records and geometry.

Negative control with insufficient total height or width, many records, border and high line-height, loading/fallback font: true clipping blocks printing, no silent text loss or font shrink; diagnostics retained, cached heights invalidate on font events.

Compare V331/V332 cold and warm Hotel Text projection and render/drag/preview/PDF cost, 1/4/100 records, cache eviction, font change; rerun View/Grid exact V330-RT-001 reproduction, tiny-card negative control, P0 safety and all other acceptance rows. No inherited PASS.

v333HotelTextDispatchRemediation.description: Confirmed in V332 index.html lines 17859,17902,17916,17927,17997–18001: renderScene passed renderer tools as the third argument to layoutText, whose new third argument means slotEffects. Spread order in text() then allowed tools.text (a function) to overwrite the bound string. V333 explicitly separates text/card dispatch, filters visual overrides to an allowlist, and assigns the bound text after overrides.

Confirmed in V332 index.html lines 18562–18564,18625–18635: the nsp-slots IIFE declared N but not V, then used V.graphicsCore.scene.shouldPaint(s) for Hotel Text custom slots. V333 explicitly binds V=V13 and N=V.nsp in that IIFE. No change to slot geometry, visibility contract or prior card fit algorithm.

Every projected text property must be a string containing the actual selected record fields, including North Riverside Grand Conference Hotel / Newcastle upon Tyne; no function source, renderer-tool keys or missing records. Create and reload an actual custom Hotel Text definition and instance; visible/hidden slot, style overrides (font, border, direction, alignment, opacity), multiple records and wrapping. No V is not defined, no unintended change to record, slot or instance geometry. Verify string content and measured rows in editor and PDF.

v334TileDependencySafety.description: Source-confirmed V333 index.html: v20VisualFields validates Tile dimensions, cells, stash coordinates and member types, but v111AssetIds only checks array/object containers; valid JSON containing a number/boolean/array as a cell, invalid stash coordinate or invalid assetId can pass dependency collection. V334 shares the existing normalization validator and routes nonempty non-text metadata to fail-closed handling. Existing validated startup rejects many such inputs; runtime reachability/data loss not established. No raw data rewrite or schema change.

Compare parsed/stored Tile bytes, library membership and reload; no schema migration or false-positive block.

v338TemplatePublicationAlbumScope.description: V337 L867–896 permits duplicate album IDs across separate public/private namespaces, while L14114–14118 and L14138–14162 flatten them into unscoped UI IDs; L14238–14293 resolves mutations and asynchronous folder upload by that ambiguous ID. A valid public/private same-ID pair can resolve a private selection to the public album, mix subtree membership, or modify the wrong folder. v339ImageIdentityOwnership.description: V338 L835, L858–862 validate image source syntax but do not verify imported hash metadata. L4623, L4656–4658, L4709, L4729, L4740, L5074 use hash equality OR actual source equality, and L14136–14145 hides distinct images with equal metadata. A valid imported record with a reused/stale hash and different source can suppress import, publication or sharing, or select a wrong original for replacement. L2735 accepts a public dependency without source by matching unverified hash, bypassing the missing-original rejection. V339 requires exact source equality for these comparisons and rejects missing public originals before deduplication; no existing source, hash or ID is rewritten. Different textual encodings may remain separate intentionally. Runtime not run.

v339ImageIdentityOwnership.description: V338 L4705–4746 explicit ownership paths allocate IDs without checking all applicable namespaces, copy archived visibility to newly granted resources, and render outside the post-commit outcome guard; L5076 allocates public upload IDs before asynchronous preparation completes and checks only active private IDs. A copied archived public original can become an invisible private grant; public collisions with an inactive private original violate L859 and inactive restore normalization L11352. V339 aligns explicit paths with permanent source ownership, exact receipts and post-commit handling, makes new grants visible, validates destination record, and allocates global IDs across active/inactive/staged source namespaces in public upload, explicit publication and portable dependency import. Auto-publication V338 already guards these namespaces and is unchanged. Runtime reachability of ID collision not established.
